Litter cam.label: Downstairs camera
Litter cam.kind: Ring Indoor Cam on the floor, facing the Litter-Robot 4

Bedroom cam.label: Upstairs camera
Bedroom cam.kind: any Ring camera facing the Litter-Robot 5; naps = also look for napping pets every 10 min (nothing is kept if a person is in view); ir_coat = in night vision a light coat is the orange cat (set it only for a camera that sees cats from across a room: up close the infrared lamp makes tabbies light too; if you move it closer, replace it with ir_coat_until = the ISO time of the move, so older clips keep the rule)
